from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its identifying title and legal classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action category identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
